title: Accenture Technology Vision 2018: Intelligent Enterprise Unleashed: Redefine Your Company Based on the Company You Keep
notes: Five trends. Labels printed in capitals with a subtitle; label given in title case, subtitle in note. Quotes are the trend summaries in the Introduction. Published date from PDF creation date (2018-02-08). Third report in the 'People First' series; fourth year of the executive survey.

entries.label: Citizen AI
entries.quote: As artificial intelligence grows in its capabilities—and its impact on people’s lives—businesses must move to “raise” their AIs to act as responsible, productive members of society.
entries.subject: Responsible AI
entries.metric: executives who believe AI will work next to humans in their organizations as co-worker, collaborator and trusted advisor
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Raising AI to Benefit Business and Society'. Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual forecast of the technology trends unfolding in the next three years.'

entries.label: Extended Reality
entries.quote: Virtual and augmented reality technologies are removing the distance to people, information, and experiences, transforming the ways people live and work.
entries.subject: Extended reality (VR/AR)
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'The End of Distance'. Present-tense survey: 27 percent of executives say it is very important to be a pioneer in XR solutions. Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual forecast of the technology trends unfolding in the next three years.'

entries.label: Data Veracity
entries.quote: By transforming themselves to run on data, businesses have created a new kind of vulnerability: inaccurate, manipulated, and biased data that leads to corrupted business insights, and skewed decisions with a major impact on society.
entries.subject: Data integrity and provenance
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'The Importance of Trust'. Present-tense survey: 79 percent of executives agree organizations base critical systems on data without verifying it. Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual forecast of the technology trends unfolding in the next three years.'

entries.label: Frictionless Business
entries.quote: Businesses depend on technology-based partnerships for growth, but their own legacy systems aren’t designed to support partnerships at scale.
entries.subject: Microservices, blockchain and smart contracts for partnerships
entries.metric: executives who say blockchain and smart contracts will be critical to their organizations
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Built to Partner at Scale'. Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual forecast of the technology trends unfolding in the next three years.'

entries.label: Internet of Thinking
entries.quote: Businesses are making big bets on intelligent environments via robotics, AI and immersive experiences.
entries.subject: Edge computing and intelligent distributed systems
entries.metric: executives who believe it will be critical to leverage custom hardware and hardware accelerators
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Creating Intelligent Distributed Systems'. Edition-level horizon: the foreword calls the report 'our annual forecast of the technology trends unfolding in the next three years.'
